info.title: AURA Intelligent Financial Workspace & Developer Platform API
info.description: AURA Developer API provides programmatic access to personal financial intelligence, recurring commitments management, automated financial planning, AG Grid data workspace saved views and selection analysis, and verified merchant operations powered by PayPal and APIMatic.
